name: tadazz
description: Create quiz drafts and custom theme/game packages, preview their native show, and choose when to save them to your Tadazz account.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit quiz drafts or complete packages with custom themes and bundled media. Check the live authoring capabilities, upload a package, build it with the native isolated worker, and preview its game in Tadazz before approving a save. Account access, native package review, and exact-version save approval remain in place. Preview interactions are demonstrations and do not cast live votes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a five-question quiz draft in Tadazz and show its interactive preview.
